AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
This tool drives the FDE curated apps store. It can list the applications curated by the FDE distribution and install any of them silently in the background.
The functions available are:
QUERY FUNCTIONS: - getAvailableApps(): Returns the list of curated apps, each with its package name, curated version and the current install / update state, so a caller can discover what is installable.
ACTION FUNCTIONS: - downloadAndInstallApp(packageName, appName): Submits a background download and silent install of a curated app, identified either by its package name (preferred, e.g. com.tencent.mm) or by its curated display name (e.g. 微信). The call returns immediately after submitting the task; the download and install continue asynchronously. QoS semantics: the function does not block until installation is complete.
